assessment_objectives.objective: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are designed and developed to achieve organization-defined levels of accuracy, resilience and cybersecurity.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are designed and developed to perform consistently with respect to accuracy, resilience and cybersecurity throughout the AAT system's lifecycle.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are designed and developed to include capabilities that enable oversight by competent individuals.
